_doc: Targets for the stills (luminance 0..1 from sRGB). Moody but readable: not muddy (too dark or too much near-black), not blown out (too much near-white). Creatures must stand out from the fog and the town behind them. Busy waves: effects may not push more than bright_share_max of the frame above bright, and the player and creatures (busy vs busy_no_actors) must stay clearly visible.
